why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the campaign on the Confidential Layer homepage Go to the Confidential Layer homepage and find the CLONE Airdrop campaign section, which invites visitors to join and earn CLONE.
2 Step 2 : Complete the daily tasks Finish the tasks the campaign sets each day and upgrade your character, as the homepage describes.
3 Step 3 : Unlock all the portals Keep progressing in the campaign until the portals are unlocked. The homepage lists this as part of earning your reward.
4 Step 4 : Connect your EVM wallet on the claim page Follow the claim guide to the claim page and connect the EVM wallet that holds your presale or airdrop allocation.

5 Step 5 : Claim your unlocked CLONE Review your total allocation, vesting schedules and claimable amount, then use the claim button for the unlocked tokens. The claim happens on the Bridgeless L1 blockchain, so add that network to your wallet.
6 Step 6 : Add the CLONE contract to your wallet After a successful claim, add the CLONE contract address given in the claim guide so your allocation shows in the wallet.
